scope: Chart-review primary; no weighted score or winner ranking

options.option: Manual review plus deterministic source checks
options.relationship: Incumbent/conventional substitute for verifiable rules; human interpretation retained
options.case_relevance: Primary strongest conventional alternative; existing source workflow is available while execution route is blocked.
options.evidence: Stipulated existing reporting foundation; analytical comparison, not a measured superiority claim.
options.reopen: A permitted chart-specific comparison shows material quality-adjusted advantage including all effort.

options.option: Constrained model assistance without an agent loop
options.case_relevance: Tests whether interpretation help requires autonomous tool selection at all.
options.evidence: Proposed design alternative; no measured task result.
options.reopen: Same-task authorized comparison establishes traceable benefit beyond adequate simple tools.

options.option: Native BI assistance such as Power BI Copilot
options.relationship: Partial alternative/complement, not certified chart validator
options.case_relevance: Relevant only if actual platform/tenant, exact surface and allowed data handling qualify; not known here.
options.reopen: Verified actual eligibility, specific supported feature/release status and traceable quality evidence. Do not replace the BI platform just to fit the example.

options.case_relevance: Needs an allowed route and local quality/effort comparison; not approved in primary.
options.evidence: S1/S6 broad context; S4 is software-task evidence only; no local chart benchmark supplied.
options.reopen: Relevant source-linked comparison on an explicitly permitted scope plus readiness/Adoption clearance.

options.case_relevance: May support integration and portability; does not create permission or task correctness.
options.evidence: S3 identified revision and implementation responsibility; S2/S5 data/evaluation guidance.
options.reopen: Host/server compatibility and consent/access/log behavior demonstrated for the exact version/route.
